card.name: Just before chelation and chelating terms
card.fires_on: Positions where the next word is likely to be "chelating" or "chelation", such as after "iron" or "exchange transfusion and" in metal-poisoning text. Also fires on the "ch" start of chelat- itself and on spaces or "of" inside edetate/lead dosing ranges.

modes.label: Start of chelat- words
modes.description: The partial word "ch" right before "elation" or "elating" in iron or lead poisoning text.
modes.example: Treatment: For specific therapy, exchange transfusion and<< ch>>elating agents should be used.

modes.label: Dose ranges in chelator labels
modes.description: Spaces or small words inside number ranges or dose phrases in edetate calcium disodium or penicillamine text.
modes.example: The total daily dose should be infused over a period of 8 to<< >>12 hours.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with a word starting "ch", as in chelating or chelation.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say chelating or chelation, the metal-removing treatment for iron or lead poisoning.
